title: How to Write a Good Email

source.name: VOA Learning English — How to Write a Good Email
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: Email is one of the most important ways through which we communicate. It has become part of most everyone’s day-to-day life.
Writing a good email can mean the difference between someone reading it and writing back, and someone ignoring it all together. Do you have questions on how to make your message more effective?
Today on Education Tips, we will answer the question, “How can I make my emails better?”

The subject line is what the other person, or receiver, will read first. The subject line is usually the most important part of an email. It should be short but contain enough details that the receiver recognizes the subject of the email. A good subject line sets the expectations for the email. A bad subject line can mean the receiver will not read the email.
As in any form of writing, you should know your audience . The opening of an email depends on things like how formal the relationship is.

The body of the email is where you ask for what you need or make clear your reason for writing the email. This could be asking them a question or keeping them informed. The body of the email should prioritize the most important information. It should be direct, and it is wise to keep it short.
If the person you are emailing does not know you, you should introduce yourself in the first few lines. You might write:

After you have introduced yourself and given your reason for writing, you can follow this with the body of your email. The most important information should come first. This makes your email clear to your receiver and saves them time. Here is an example.
It is important to clearly explain yourself in as few words as possible. Try to keep your email short, but polite . This is important because you want to make yourself clear to your receiver.

The last part to a good email is the closing. It is usually one or two words that let the receiver know that this is the end of the email. The ending should include your name and tell the receiver where you work and what you do. A few different closings are:
Some applications create an automatic signature for the sender. This is useful because it saves time when you are writing.
If you follow these suggestions, you will find that you receive more responses to your emails. Effective email writing is important especially now when so much of what we do is online.

questions.q: According to the writer, why is the subject line so important?
options: It is the first thing the reader sees and may decide whether the email gets read
It is the longest part of the message, so it takes most of the writer’s time
It tells the reader where you work and what your job is
It replaces the opening greeting, so the email can begin straight away
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: người nhận đọc subject line đầu tiên; “a bad subject line can mean the receiver will not read the email”.

questions.q: In paragraph 5, what does “know your audience” mean for the opening of an email?
options: Begin with a joke so that the reader is interested in your email
Use the same greeting for every person, however well you know them
Choose a greeting that suits how well you know the reader
Leave the opening out when the email is short and the subject clear
questions.explain: Đoạn 5: lời mở đầu phụ thuộc vào “how formal the relationship is” ≈ chọn cách chào phù hợp với mức độ quen biết.

questions.q: What should you do if the person you are writing to has never met you?
options: Ask them to introduce themselves first
Write a longer message than usual
Say who you are in the first lines
Wait until the closing to give your name
questions.explain: Đoạn 7: “you should introduce yourself in the first few lines”.

questions.q: Why does the writer recommend putting the most important information first?
options: It makes the message clear and saves the reader’s time
It means the closing can be left out
Readers usually stop reading after the first sentence
It replaces the need for a subject line
questions.explain: Đoạn 8: thông tin quan trọng nhất đặt trước “makes your email clear to your receiver and saves them time”.

questions.q: What is the writer’s attitude to automatic signatures?
options: Cautious, because they may contain mistakes
Positive, because they save the sender time
Neutral, because they are rarely used
Negative, because they look impersonal
questions.explain: Đoạn 11: chữ ký tự động “is useful because it saves time when you are writing”.

questions.q: The writer thinks an email should contain as much detail as possible.
questions.explain: Đoạn 9: nên giải thích rõ “in as few words as possible”, giữ email ngắn nhưng lịch sự.

questions.q: Emails sent in the morning receive more replies than emails sent in the afternoon.
questions.explain: Bài không nói gì về thời điểm gửi email.
